title: Extend watcher provenance tests across launch, overflow and negative diagnostic paths
outcome: Extend watcher provenance tests across launch, overflow and negative diagnostic paths
acceptance: Deterministic production-handoff controls cover active-check launch-window provenance carried to settlement, second-event first-record retention there, directory-overflow unknown-root fencing, and unrelated-root/access events producing neither a fence nor diagnostic; genuine and uncertain changes stay conservative.
